item.text: {"iteration":2,"pcvs":[{"name":"row_count","expression":"len(output_token_ids)","rationale":"Captures per-row traversal and conversion overhead."},{"name":"token_count","expression":"sum(len(row) for row in output_token_ids)","rationale":"Captures conversion of existing token IDs."},{"name":"padded_elements","expression":"len(output_token_ids) * max((len(row) for row in output_token_ids), default=0)","rationale":"Captures tensor allocation and padding work."},{"name":"single_element_tensor","expression":"int(len(output_token_ids) * max((len(row) for row in output_token_ids), default=0) == 1)","rationale":"Separates the unusually costly single-element input observed in the report."}],"hypothesis":"A separate single-element regime plus linear row, token, and padding costs explains the observations.
